prompt: Describe microservices architecture patterns. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Every single word must contain an even number of letters. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: No punctuation except periods at sentence terminals. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 3: Exactly two sentences.
evaluation_criteria:
Even Letter Words: 0-5 (Evaluates word length parity check)
Punctuation And Length: 0-5 (Evaluates sentence count and punctuation limits)
response_text: Each microservice uses some separate database area to keep data isolated with gateways managing user flow. Some choreography or orchestrator mode will help manage workflow well.
